findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: btc_price, base64_convert, l402_recheck · Private data: tx_decode_explain, json_validate, hash_generate, base64_convert, business_ratios, l402_recheck · Public sink: btc_price, btc_send_decision, optimal_send_window, json_extract, l402_recheck.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: btc_price, base64_convert, l402_recheck · Private data: tx_decode_explain, json_validate, hash_generate, base64_convert, business_ratios, l402_recheck · Public sink: btc_price, btc_send_decision, optimal_send_window, json_extract, l402_recheck

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "btc_price" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
